```{r data}
load_processed_data(
  "./data/pathogenwatch/curated/pathogenwatch_data.RDS",
  c(
    "ng_sample_metadata",
    "ng_meta",
    "pathogenwatch_isolate_data",
    "resistance_variables",

    "chosen_genome_ids"
  )
)
```

# Spatiotemporal data
```{r}
paste0("Number of genomes in dataset: ",nrow(ng_sample_metadata))

# Temporal data
paste0("Temporal data")
collection_year_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  summarise(
    genomes_with_year = sum(!is.na(collection_year)),
    genomes_in_2010s = sum(collection_decade == 2010, na.rm = TRUE),
    percent_in_2010s = 100 * mean(collection_decade == 2010, na.rm = TRUE),
    median_year = median(collection_year, na.rm = TRUE),
    year_q1 = unname(quantile(collection_year, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)),
    year_q3 = unname(quantile(collection_year, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)),
    missing_year = sum(is.na(collection_year))
  )

collection_year_summary %>% favorite_kable()

# Location data
paste0("Location data")
paste0("Number with continent data: ", sum(is.na(pathogenwatch_isolate_data$collection_continent)==F))
paste0("Percent with continent data: ", sum(is.na(pathogenwatch_isolate_data$collection_continent)==F)/nrow(pathogenwatch_isolate_data)*100)

paste0("Continent data")
continent_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_continent)) %>%
  count(collection_continent, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

continent_summary %>% favorite_kable()

paste0("Country data")
paste0("Number of represented counties: ",pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(collection_country), collection_country != "Unknown")  %>% .$collection_country %>% n_distinct)

country_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(collection_country), collection_country != "Unknown") %>%
  count(collection_country, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percent_all_genomes = 100 * n / nrow(pathogenwatch_isolate_data))

country_summary %>% favorite_kable()
```

# Sequence type data
```{r}
paste0("Number of isolates without ST call: ", sum(is.na(pathogenwatch_isolate_data$sequence_type)))

paste0("Number of ST calls: ", n_distinct(pathogenwatch_isolate_data$sequence_type))

sequence_type_summary <- pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>%
  filter(!is.na(sequence_type)) %>%
  count(sequence_type, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(percent = 100 * n / sum(n))

sequence_type_summary %>% favorite_kable()
```



# Resistance data
## Predicted phenotypes
```{r}
resistance_summary <- summarise_resistance(
  pathogenwatch_isolate_data,
  isolate_column = "genome_id",
  resistance_levels = c("RESISTANT", "INTERMEDIATE", "NOT_FOUND"),
  resistance_columns = resistance_variables
) %>%
  filter(value != "NOT_FOUND") %>%
  group_by(variable) %>%
  summarise(n = sum(n), percent = sum(perc), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(variable = as.character(variable)) %>%
  arrange(match(variable, resistance_variables))

paste0("Resistance data: ")
resistance_summary %>% favorite_kable()
```

## Genotype data
```{r}
raw_mutation_variables <- setdiff(
  colnames(ng_meta),
  c("Isolate", "Genome Name.y", resistance_variables)
)

paste0("Number of considered genotypes: ",length(raw_mutation_variables))

raw_mutation_variables 

paste0("Number of distinct resistance-associated loci: ", n_distinct(sub("_.*", "", raw_mutation_variables)))
```

# Genotype and phenotype patterns
```{r}
paste0("Distinct raw genotype and resistance patterns: ", ng_meta %>% select(all_of(c(resistance_variables, raw_mutation_variables))) %>% distinct() %>% nrow()) # distinct raw genotype and resistance patterns)

paste0("Distinct gene-grouped genotype and resistance pattern: ", pathogenwatch_isolate_data %>% select(all_of(c(resistance_variables, mutation_variables))) %>% distinct() %>% nrow() ) # distinct gene-grouped genotype and resistance patterns)
```
